# 🔒 THE LUXORA COLLECTIVE  
## PRODUCTIZED DELIVERABLES SOP  
**Version 1.0 | Internal Use Only**

---

## 🎯 OBJECTIVE
Reduce customization time, increase perceived value, and standardize delivery by using **pre-built Luxora assets** that are deployed consistently across all clients.

This SOP defines:
- What assets are pre-made
- What format each asset lives in
- When each asset is delivered
- What (if anything) is customized

---

## 📦 ASSET DELIVERY TIERS (HIGH LEVEL)

| Tier | Description |
|----|----|
| **Vault Assets** | Pre-made PDFs/Canva decks sent to every client |
| **Template Assets** | Light fill-in templates |
| **Custom Execution** | Built live per client |

---

**Delivered to 100% of clients | No customization**

These assets are locked, branded, and reused forever.
